verses.ar: «رُوحِي تَلِفَتْ. أَيَّامِي ٱنْطَفَأَتْ. إِنَّمَا ٱلْقُبُورُ لِي.
verses.kjv: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves [are ready] for me.
verses.web: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

verses.ar: «لَوْلَا ٱلْمُخَاتِلُونَ عِنْدِي، وَعَيْنِي تَبِيتُ عَلَى مُشَاجَرَاتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: [Are there] not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.web: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

verses.ar: كُنْ ضَامِنِي عِنْدَ نَفْسِكَ. مَنْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُصَفِّقُ يَدِي؟
verses.kjv: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who [is] he [that] will strike hands with me?
verses.web: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ مَنَعْتَ قَلْبَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْفِطْنَةِ، لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ لَا تَرْفَعُهُمُ.
verses.kjv: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt [them].
verses.web: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يُسَلِّمُ ٱلْأَصْحَابَ لِلسَّلْبِ، تَتْلَفُ عُيُونُ بَنِيهِ.
verses.kjv: He that speaketh flattery to [his] friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.web: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

verses.ar: أَوْقَفَنِي مَثَلًا لِلشُّعُوبِ، وَصِرْتُ لِلْبَصْقِ فِي ٱلْوَجْهِ.
verses.kjv: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.web: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

verses.ar: كَلَّتْ عَيْنِي مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ، وَأَعْضَائِي كُلُّهَا كَٱلظِّلِّ.
verses.kjv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members [are] as a shadow.
verses.web: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

verses.ar: يَتَعَجَّبُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُونَ مِنْ هَذَا، وَٱلْبَرِئُ يَنْتَهِضُ عَلَى ٱلْفَاجِرِ.
verses.kjv: Upright [men] shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.web: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ فَيَسْتَمْسِكُ بِطَرِيقِهِ، وَٱلطَّاهِرُ ٱلْيَدَيْنِ يَزْدَادُ قُوَّةً.
verses.kjv: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.web: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

verses.ar: «وَلَكِنِ ٱرْجِعُوا كُلُّكُمْ وَتَعَالَوْا، فَلَا أَجِدُ فِيكُمْ حَكِيمًا.
verses.kjv: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find [one] wise [man] among you.
verses.web: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

verses.ar: أَيَّامِي قَدْ عَبَرَتْ. مَقَاصِدِي، إِرْثُ قَلْبِي، قَدِ ٱنْتَزَعَتْ.
verses.kjv: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, [even] the thoughts of my heart.
verses.web: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُونَ ٱللَّيْلَ نَهَارًا، نُورًا قَرِيبًا لِلظُّلْمَةِ.
verses.kjv: They change the night into day: the light [is] short because of darkness.
verses.web: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

verses.ar: إِذَا رَجَوْتُ ٱلْهَاوِيَةَ بَيْتًا لِي، وَفِي ٱلظَّلَامِ مَهَّدْتُ فِرَاشِي،
verses.kjv: If I wait, the grave [is] mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.web: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

verses.ar: وَقُلْتُ لِلْقَبْرِ: أَنْتَ أَبِي، وَلِلدُّودِ: أَنْتَ أُمِّي وَأُخْتِي،
verses.kjv: I have said to corruption, Thou [art] my father: to the worm, [Thou art] my mother, and my sister.
verses.web: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

verses.ar: فَأَيْنَ إِذًا آمَالِي؟ آمَالِي، مَنْ يُعَايِنُهَا؟
verses.kjv: And where [is] now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.web: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

verses.ar: تَهْبِطُ إِلَى مَغَالِيقِ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ إِذْ تَرْتَاحُ مَعًا فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ».
verses.kjv: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when [our] rest together [is] in the dust.
verses.web: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
